description: This Java test class verifies the functionality and validation logic of the DefaultNamespacedEntityId class, including immutability, equality, namespace and name handling, length restrictions, and special character allowances.

classes.name: DefaultNamespacedEntityIdTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for verifying behaviors of DefaultNamespacedEntityId class, including validation, immutability, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of DefaultNamespacedEntityId are immutable.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations via EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: fromNameHasEmptyNamespace
methods.description: Checks that creating an ID from a name results in an ID with an empty namespace.

methods.name: defaultNamespacedEntityIdFromDefaultNamespacedEntityIdIsSameInstance
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ID from an existing ID returns the same instance.

methods.name: defaultNamespacedEntityIdFromNamespacedEntityIdSkipsValidation
methods.description: Tests that the constructor can bypass validation, creating an ID with invalid namespace and name.

methods.name: canHaveMaximumLengthOf256Characters
methods.description: Tests that an ID can have a maximum length of 256 characters.

methods.name: cannotHaveMoreThan256Characters
methods.description: Ensures IDs longer than 256 characters are invalid.

methods.name: nullId
methods.description: Checks that passing null to ID creation throws an exception.

methods.name: nullName
methods.description: Checks that null name results in an exception.

methods.name: nullNamespace
methods.description: Checks that null namespace throws an exception when creating an ID.

methods.name: testConstantsAreValid
methods.description: Validates that sample constants are considered valid IDs.

methods.name: toStringConcatenatesNamespaceAndName
methods.description: Verifies the string representation concatenates namespace and name correctly.

methods.name: placeholderIsPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks that a dummy ID is recognized as a placeholder.

methods.name: manuallyCreatedPlaceholderIsPlaceholder
methods.description: Verifies that certain manually created IDs are recognized as placeholders.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Tests creation of a valid ID with normal namespace and name.

methods.name: nameStartsWithColon
methods.description: Checks that a name starting with a colon is valid.

methods.name: emptyNamespace
methods.description: Ensures IDs with empty namespace are valid.

methods.name: onlyColons
methods.description: Tests ID with only colons as namespace and name.

methods.name: withValidSpecialCharactersInName
methods.description: Verifies that names with allowed special characters are valid.

methods.name: paragraphSymbolNotAllowed
methods.description: Ensures names with paragraph symbols are invalid.

methods.name: numbersAfterDotInNamespacedIsNotAllowed
methods.description: Checks that digits after a dot in namespace are invalid.

methods.name: namespacesWithLeadingDotAreInvalid
methods.description: Ensures that namespace starting with a dot is invalid.

methods.name: numbersInNamespacesAreAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that numerals in namespace are valid.

methods.name: mutliplePrecedingDotsInNamespaceAreNotAllowed
methods.description: Checks that multiple leading dots in namespace are invalid.

methods.name: notSpecialCharactersInNamespacesAreAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that certain characters like '$' are invalid in namespace.
